concept: Establish three forward Barracks and use nonstop Marine production to overwhelm the opponent before converting a surviving proxy into sustained bio pressure.
rules: Check emergency_defence first, then proxy_pressure. Otherwise use opening, proxy_construction, proxy_pressure, marine_macro.
Use three SCVs to build three forward Barracks and protect the proxy from small enemy worker pulls when possible.
Keep producing Marines and rally them toward the main squad; do not delay the first attack for gas technology.
Before a second base is established, prioritize minerals, Supply Depots, and Marine count; after it is safe, add basic infantry upgrades and normal production support.

enter_when: The three proxy workers have not yet begun forward construction.
phases.goal: Start the fastest practical three-Barracks Marine proxy.
guidance: Train early SCVs, build a Supply Depot at 13 supply, and send three workers to a pathable forward location.
Avoid early gas and expansion spending.

phases.goal: Finish the proxy and build the first grouped Marine force.
guidance: Finish three forward Barracks and repair or fight with proxy SCVs when enemy workers try to stop construction.
Start Marine production from each ready Barracks and rally the first Marines together.

enter_when: At least one forward Barracks is ready.
Marines are gathering near the proxy or attacking the enemy.
phases.goal: Use continuous Marine reinforcements to break the enemy economy or contain it.
guidance: Attack workers, production, or exposed defensive units with grouped Marines.
Do not trickle Marines into a fortified ramp; attack an exposed base or contain the enemy if the entrance is sealed.
Maintain Supply Depots so forward production does not stop.

enter_when: The first pressure has created space, or a second town hall has been established.
phases.goal: Extend the proxy into a mineral-heavy Marine game.
guidance: Expand when safe, keep a Marine-focused composition, add gas after the second base, and start Combat Shield plus infantry upgrades.
Add more Barracks when minerals accumulate while using the proxy to keep reinforcements close to the opponent.

enter_when: A hostile force threatens the main base or worker line while most Marines are forward.
phases.goal: Stabilize home without throwing away the whole forward army.
guidance: Recall enough Marines to protect workers and production, pulling SCVs only when necessary.
Resume pressure after the main base is stable.
